# MindGains AI

> MindGains is an Indian exam-preparation platform for UPSC, TNPSC, SSC and other government exams. It offers textbook-grounded AI answers, 160,000+ practice questions with real previous-year questions, daily current affairs, NationLap (a live quiz race against aspirants across India) and the Live Theatre, a 3D study hall where students watch classes together.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://mindgains.ai/): overview of MindGains
- [MindGains Pro](https://mindgains.ai/pro/): plans from ₹99/month; unlimited Live Theatre, Batch rooms for friends and classmates; Teacher plans from ₹299/month
- [NationLap](https://mindgains.ai/play/): live national quiz race
- [Live Theatre](https://mindgains.ai/play/theatre/): 3D study hall with live classes, chat and quizzes (30 minutes free daily)
